detail.longDescription: I’ve significantly optimized (aggressively deduplicated) the contents of https:// scheme-index.aartaka.me . Now the largest file there (r7rs_all) only weights 2.5MB instead of some 3.7 megs. Now, y’all might be like “wtf Artyom, 2.5 megs for a single # HTML document, how is that small to you?!” But I have to remind y’all: scheme-index is _all_ of # Scheme standard libraries and all (documented) # SRFI s—on one webpage. If you’d’ve tried to fit just the C++ standard on a single HTML page, it’d take a gigabyte or something. So go use https:// scheme-index.aartaka.me and enjoy entirely JS-less docs for a small neat thing Scheme is. # webdev # theWorkshop
